pages.lesson:
LESSON: TYPES OF DIVORCE • AT-TALAQ • KHUL’U

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.2: Types of divorce • at-Talaq • khul’u

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Types of divorce • at-Talaq • khul’u. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are the reasons for khul’u’?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain at-Talaq and Khul’u types of divorce as provided in the Quran and Hadith
2. describe the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u according to Islamic teachings
3. explain the effects of divorce in society

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain at-Talaq and Khul’u types of divorce as provided in the Quran and Hadith
   In simple words: practise until you can explain at-Talaq and Khul’u types of divorce as provided in the Quran and Hadith. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u according to Islamic teachings
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u according to Islamic teachings. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. explain the effects of divorce in society
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the effects of divorce in society. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Types of divorce • at-Talaq • khul’u using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Types of divorce • at-Talaq • khul’u in the examples.
2. Explain Types of divorce • at-Talaq • khul’u to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Types of divorce • at-Talaq • khul’u.
4. Show that you can: explain at-Talaq and Khul’u types of divorce as provided in the Quran and Hadith

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Types of divorce • at-Talaq • khul’u using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Types of divorce • at-Talaq • khul’u important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the steps involved in at- Talaq and Khul’u according to Islamic teachings in groups and present on charts/power points,
2. Listen to a resource person (kadhi/imam) giving a talk on the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u,
3. Learning to learn: enhanced as learners learn independently through listening to a resource person (kadhi/imam) on the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u.
4. Communication and collaboration: enhanced as learners speak effectively and engagingly when discussing the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the reasons for khul’u’?
2. What are the effects of talaq?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain at-Talaq and Khul’u types of divorce as provided in the Quran and Hadith
2. describe the steps involved in at-Talaq and Khul’u according to Islamic teachings
3. explain the effects of divorce in society

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
